name: Sentinel Tower
summary: At Sentinel Tower, defenders watch Westfall and organize resistance against bandits, gnolls, and the Defias Brotherhood. Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia hold the line.

sections.title: Watch over the Wild West
sections.body: Sentinel Tower watches over Westfall's unsettled plains. With Stormwind's army largely absent and aid withheld, local volunteers and veterans have gathered around this stronghold. From its stone heights, lookouts see across dusty plains, past abandoned pumpkin patches to the misty shores. They watch for highwaymen and gnoll raiding parties moving through the region.

sections.title: Headquarters of the Militia
sections.body: Gryan Stoutmantle and local leaders direct the militia from Sentinel Tower. Makeshift defenses ring the stronghold, where wounded refugees and weary soldiers gather. Homesteaders driven from their lands find emergency shelter there. Militia members piece together reports about the Defias Brotherhood and organize volunteers for strikes against the syndicate that has brought Westfall to ruin.

faq.q: Who is in charge at Sentinel Tower?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle directs operations from Sentinel Tower. As head of the People's Militia, he coordinates Westfall's displaced farmers in their defense and recruits willing adventurers.

faq.q: Why is the tower so important to Westfall?
faq.answer: Sentinel Tower is the only fortified garrison and lookout post left in the central plains. Stormwind has left Westfall largely undefended, making the tower the region's last organized bastion of order and safety for refugees.

faq.q: Who stays in and around the tower?
faq.answer: Militia officers, sentinels on watch, quartermasters, and farmsteader families stay in and around Sentinel Tower. The families left their ruined lands to seek shelter near its stone walls.

faq.q: What threats are watched from the tower?
aliases: what does the tower guard against
faq.answer: Sentinels watch for Riverpaw gnolls, murlocs moving inland from the coast, and roaming highwaymen and brigands of the Defias Brotherhood.

angles.text: Sentinel Tower shows the grit of ordinary Alliance subjects fighting for their homeland while Stormwind's high lords turn a blind eye.
As a human of the kingdom, you see Stormwind's agrarian breadbasket barely holding together against rebellion from within.
